newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent indicated weaker, NYMEX down after API.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent indicated weaker, NYMEX down after API.

text.p: Brent crude futures were indicated weaker on Thursday, while NYMEX was down but supported on crack trading in the wake of API data.
Brokers said the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping was not having an affect on sentiment.

"Headlines are around, but there has been no reaction in oil and I would not expect one," one broker said. April Brent was untraded and quoted on SIMEX at $20.46/$20.56 per barrel, down from London's $20.63.
NYMEX though saw a slide in crude values during ACCESS trading in the wake of American Petroleum Institute (API) data, which showed a crude build of 3.12 million barrels, above some expectations.

NYMEX March crude was down 22 cents at $22.57 on ACCESS from New York's close, but crack buyers against both heating oil and gasoline were offering some support. NYMEX volume was a healthy 2,946 lots in the front two months.
